seoTitle: Crawler IP Range Checker for Googlebot, Bingbot and GPTBot
metaDescription: Paste a crawler operator's published IP range JSON and test IP addresses against it. Works with Google, Bing and OpenAI lists. Free.
intro: Checks whether IPv4 and IPv6 addresses fall inside the ranges of a JSON file or CIDR list you paste.
why:
A user-agent claiming to be Googlebot proves nothing. The operators publish the IP ranges of their crawlers as JSON, and a request from outside them is not the real bot.

Download the current file yourself, paste it with your IPs, and see which are in range. The tool reads the prefix fields of the JSON and any CIDR line, for IPv4 and IPv6. It makes no network requests, so you need a fresh copy of the list.
howTo: Paste it in the first box.
Paste the IPs from your log.

faq.a: Any text that contains CIDR ranges or IPs, including Google, Bing and OpenAI JSON files.

faq.q: Why not fetch the lists for me?
faq.a: That is a network request, which this site does not make.
